name: auto-jira-log
description: Claude Code plugins that log development work to Jira, push it to origin, and sync token usage across machines.

plugins.name: jira-log
plugins.description: Links a worktree to a Jira Cloud issue, records the work done on it, and posts a reviewed daily update comment.

plugins.name: git-push
plugins.description: Pushes the branch and opens its Azure DevOps pull request from buttons above the prompt, then shows the pull request's status there.

plugins.name: worktree-hooks
plugins.description: Starts each worktree from the latest commit of the branch it is made from: creates it from a fresh fetch, or fast-forwards a fresh desktop worktree when its session starts.

plugins.name: hook-logger
plugins.description: Logs every hook event Claude Code fires, with its full input, to a file. For finding out which events fire, and when.

plugins.name: usage-sync
plugins.description: Records this device's Claude Code token usage and syncs it to a GitHub repository, so usage from every machine adds up in one place.
